statement: INSERT INTO workspace.mlpab3b210e.recs2ead15 WITH scores AS (SELECT u.user_id AS user_id, i.item_id AS item_id, (u.e1*i.e1 + u.e2*i.e2 + u.e3*i.e3 + u.e4*i.e4 + u.e5*i.e5 + u.e6*i.e6 + u.e7*i.e7 + u.e8*i.e8) AS score FROM workspace.mlpab3b210e.stg_user_emb u CROSS JOIN workspace.mlpab3b210e.stg_item_emb i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace.mlpab3b210e.stg_interactions x WHERE x.user_id = u.user_id AND x.item_id = i.item_id)), ranked AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY score DESC, item_id ASC) AS rnk FROM scores) SELECT concat(user_id, '#', CAST(rnk AS STRING)) AS rec_id, user_id, CAST(rnk AS INT) AS rank, item_id FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5
